title: Sandman: Building and Operating Sandboxes for Agentic Reinforcement Learning on Shared Kubernetes
abstract: arXiv:2610.39711v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) often requires repeated tool calls in task-specific environments. A training job may create thousands of these environments in bursts while sharing a cluster with other jobs. We present Sandman, a sandbox service built and operated at Amazon for agent tool execution and evaluation. It serves multiple production agentic RL workloads on shared Kubernetes. A training framework supplies a task image and uses commands and file operations in the returned sandbox. Files and processes persist across calls until the framework releases the environment. Sandman manages creation, readiness and cleanup. Each sandbox is a Kubernetes pod with a small daemon mounted into the unmodified image. In a scale test, Sandman held 11,858 concurrent tiny sandboxes. Four production SWE-bench Verified training campaigns created 3.1 million sandboxes in October 2026. translated_title: Sandman：在共享Kubernetes上为智能体强化学习构建和运营沙箱
translated_abstract: 智能体强化学习（RL）通常需要在特定任务环境中反复调用工具。一个训练任务可能在突发情况下创建数千个这样的环境，同时与其他任务共享集群。我们提出了Sandman，这是亚马逊构建和运营的一个沙箱服务，用于智能体的工具执行与评估。它在共享的Kubernetes上服务于多个生产级智能体RL工作负载。训练框架提供一个任务镜像，并在返回的沙箱中执行命令和文件操作。文件和进程在多次调用之间持续存在，直到框架释放该环境。Sandman负责管理环境的创建、就绪和清理。每个沙箱是一个Kubernetes pod，其中包含一个挂载到未修改镜像中的小型守护进程。在一项规模测试中，Sandman承载了11,858个并发的微型沙箱。四项生产级SWE-bench Verified训练任务在2026年10月共创建了310万个沙箱。我们报告了相关的设计权衡和运营经验。
tldr: Sandman是亚马逊在共享Kubernetes上构建的沙箱服务，可高效管理智能体强化学习训练中数百万个工具执行环境的创建、持久化与清理。
en_tdlr: Sandman is a sandbox service built and operated by Amazon on shared Kubernetes that efficiently manages the creation, persistence, and cleanup of millions of tool-execution environments for agentic RL training.
